title: Inception
description: A thief who steals corporate secrets through dream-sharing technology is given a chance to erase his criminal history by planting an idea into a target's mind.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman faces the Joker, a criminal mastermind who plunges Gotham into chaos and forces the hero to confront the thin line between justice and vengeance.

title: Interstellar
description: A team of explorers travels through a wormhole in space in an attempt to ensure humanity's survival as Earth becomes uninhabitable.

title: The Matrix
description: A computer hacker discovers that reality as he knows it is a simulation and joins a rebellion to free humanity from the machines that control it.

title: Pulp Fiction
description: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster and his wife intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption in Los Angeles.

title: Forrest Gump
description: The presidencies of Kennedy and Johnson, the Vietnam War, and other historic events unfold from the perspective of an Alabama man with a big heart.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: Two imprisoned men bond over a number of years, finding solace and eventual redemption through acts of common decency.

title: Spirited Away
description: A young girl wanders into a world ruled by gods and spirits where humans are changed into beasts and she must find a way to free her parents.

title: Toy Story
description: A cowboy doll is profoundly threatened when a new spaceman action figure supplants him as the top toy in a boy's bedroom.

title: The Conjuring
description: Paranormal investigators help a family terrorized by a dark presence in their farmhouse and uncover the horrifying truth behind it.

title: Get Out
description: A young Black man visits his white girlfriend's family estate and uncovers a disturbing truth about the people living there.

title: Parasite
description: A poor family schemes to become employed by a wealthy household by infiltrating their lives one job at a time, with unexpected consequences.

title: Se7en
description: Two detectives hunt a serial killer who uses the seven deadly sins as his motives, leading them to a shocking final discovery.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
description: A legendary concierge at a famous hotel and his protégé become involved in the theft of a priceless painting and a battle for a fortune.

title: Superbad
description: Two co-dependent high school seniors attempt to score alcohol for a party, leading to a series of misadventures before graduation.
